messages:
maya: quick heads-up — ran the quarterly access sampler for admin roles, found a small cluster of KMS-privileged svcaccts that have never been touched in >180d :eyes:

sam: can you paste the exact check you ran? wondering if it covers delegated grants across projects too

maya: yep — two parts: 1) list principals with any kms:* or cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter over more than one project, 2) ownerless keys that map to those principals. quick SQL used on our cloudtrail export:```SELECT principal, resource_name, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM cloudtrail_events WHERE eventName LIKE '%Kms%' GROUP BY principal, resource_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 3```

jordan: nice. my read — a few svcaccts were created by old onboarding jobs and got a blanket role. propose a "surgical canary prune": remove high-risk role from a tiny set (2 svcaccts), monitor errors, then widen if OK.

alex: flagged one case: svc-acct-dataflow-ingest@proj-prod still has kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on master-key. removing that breaks daily ingest. we should not prune it until we have a fallback key or rebind to a scoped key. :warning:

maya: good catch. plan = triage list into 3 buckets: SAFE (no production binds), CANARY (low-traffic non-prod or throttled jobs), BLOCK (prod-critical).

rina: volunteer to run the canary tomorrow. what metrics are we watching? latency errors? failed decrypts? logs?

maya: primary signals: KMS API error rate (AccessDenied), decrypt failures in apps, deploy-time errors, and elevating pager noise (our incident bot). also token-owner change events. set alert thresholds low for the canary: 3/min for AccessDenied in the first hour, 10 total failed decrypts in 24h = rollback.

sam: two policy/Qs: 1) are we revoking IAM roles or modifying key-level bindings? 2) how do we ensure audit evidence for compliance?

jordan: we edit key IAM bindings (least-privilege) rather than org-wide role removal when possible. for evidence we export CloudAuditLogs to the audit GCS and snapshot the key policy and iambindings before change. add commit hash and runbook ID to the snapshot metadata.

maya: exact rollback command if we see spike:```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/k --member="serviceAccount:svc@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"```we'll keep the prior policy blob saved as `surgical-prune/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json`.

alex: also suggest temporary protective guard: add condition binding instead of dropping entirely, e.g., time-bound deny or restrict by service account tag. Example patch snippet:```- members: ...  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter  condition:
    title: temporary-restrict
    expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-08T00:00:00Z")
```

rina: perfect. i'll run the canary step and post logs. timeline: start 10:00 PT, 1 svcacct in CANARY, run for 6h, escalate at first sign.

sec-bot: scheduled: Access-review canary job created for thread 3287654321, start=2026-03-22T17:00:00Z, owners=[rina].

sam: one more ask — compliance wants a short justification template for each removed entitlement. could someone draft 2-3 bullets we can attach to the snapshot?

maya: draft template: - prior role and binding blob reference (surgical-prune/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json) - observed risk (unused, cross-project access, ownerless) - planned mitigation (rebind to scoped key / rotate to scoped key) - verification checklist (no AccessDenied spikes, telemetry pass)

jordan: i added the SQL to the shared drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/sec/access-sampler — includes the ownerless-key join and sample of keys older than 180d.

alex: once canary passes, we should schedule a 2-week phased rollout with weekly snapshots. also create an automation ticket to re-evaluate any svcacct that regains permissions (audit alert on regrant).

maya: action items summarized: RINA run canary + paste logs to thread, JORDAN update SQL with project exclusions, ALEX prepare rollback cut/paste, SAM draft compliance justification template, MAYA will kick off phased rollout if canary green. target: decision by 2026-03-24 EOD. :lock: :white_check_mark:

rina: on it — will post results and grepped logs under `surgical-prune/${thread_ts}/canary-logs.txt`

maya: thanks all. keep replies here for the audit trail.
